relationships.subject: FD-22a
relationships.evidence_quote: FD-22a revealed to efficiently prevent the inflammatory response induced by an LPS stimulus, as shown by the observed significant decrease of IL-6 release (Figure 5A) and concomitant increase of IL-10 release (Figure 5C).

relationships.subject: SR144528
relationships.evidence_quote: the modulatory activity of FD-22a on both IL-6 and IL-10 release totally reverted in the presence of CB2R antagonist SR144528 (1 μM)

relationships.subject: FD-22a
relationships.evidence_quote: A single administration (p.o.) of FD-22a dose-dependently (1–20 mg kg–1) relieved neuropathic pain starting from the dose of 5 mg kg–1.

relationships.subject: FD-22a
relationships.evidence_quote: This assay demonstrated that FD-22a and FD-24a are able to inhibit FSK-stimulated cAMP accumulation by hCB2R activation.

key_findings: Bitopic CB2R ligand FD-22a is CB2-selective over CB1, biased toward cAMP over beta-arrestin2, and reduces IL-6/raises IL-10 in microglia via CB2R.
Oral FD-22a reverses oxaliplatin-induced cold allodynia in mice, dependent on CB2R.
